info.name: Habit Tracker API
info.description:
Run the requests in order, top to bottom. Register (or Log in) first: it saves your token. "Create habit" saves habitId for the rest.

Set the baseUrl collection variable to your deployed URL to test a hosted copy. Interactive docs are at {{baseUrl}}/docs.

The last folder (Account) changes the password and then deletes the account. Skip it if you want to keep the account.

exec: // Dates used by the entry requests, in the local calendar.

const iso = (offset) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); };

request.description: Creates an account and returns a token. Returns 409 if the email already exists: use Log in instead.
Every habit with streaks, whether today is done, and the last 14 days. This is what the web app loads.

item.name: Create habit with a weekly goal

request.description: Leave entry_date out to use today (UTC). Posting the same date again updates it.

exec: pm.test("Has rates and milestones", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.completion_rate).to.have.property("days_30"); pm.expect(b.milestones).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(b.weekly_history).to.have.lengthOf(8); });
